title: Lake Minnow Rising
author: Sable Eriksen
blurb: Ulyana Coldharbour, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
